prompt:
Summarise the meeting transcript below in a short paragraph.
Include what was decided, who owns each action, and any dates.

Transcript:
Pricing review, 19 March.
Dana: churn on the starter tier is 4.1%, up from 3.3% two quarters ago.
Marcus: the people leaving are the ones who never connected a second data source.
Dana: so onboarding, not price.
Marcus: I think so. Raising the price would make the number worse, not better.
Dana: decision — we hold the starter price at 29 and fund an onboarding revamp instead.
Marcus: I will draft the scope by the 27th and Dana approves it.
Dana: and we drop the discount experiment. It moved nothing in six weeks.


Summary:
response:
Here is a summary of the meeting transcript:

The team decided to hold the price of the starter tier at $29, rather than raising it, due to high churn rates being caused by onboarding issues rather than pricing. Instead, they will fund an onboarding revamp. Marcus will draft the scope for this project by March 27th and Dana will approve it. Additionally, the discount experiment was dropped as it had no impact in six weeks.
